<!-- bot0-gitcode-native-export -->

Paired: [GitHub #10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/10) ↔ [GitCode !98](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/98)

## 变更类型

/kind feature

## 背景

本 PR 补齐 Agent 工具调用的结构化追踪信息。目标是让 Agent 运行过程中各种工具的正常结果、业务失败、参数错误、策略拦截、循环保护和执行异常，都能通过现有运行记录链路定位到对应工具调用和错误详情。

这次不新增 UI，也不新增独立审计 JSONL、日志索引或日志 list 文件。

## 修改前情况

- 工具执行结果主要以模型可见的 `content` 文本进入 history / run stream；结构化元数据没有统一从工具层透传到 runtime、run trace、subagent step 和 versioning observation。
- 部分工具本身已经有独立记录，例如 Shell / Execution 的 stdout、stderr、状态和日志，MCP invocation、Artifact/provenance、CAS 等也已有各自存储；但 Agent run 事件里缺少统一的 `details` 线索，报错时需要靠文本内容或外部记录反查。
- Registry 内部产生的错误或控制结果，例如参数错误、未知工具、能力策略禁用、deferred tool 未提升、循环保护、batch supersede、工具抛异常，之前缺少稳定结构化 code，问题定位不够直接。
- `tool_search` 之前只返回模型可见文本，无法在 run trace 里看到 query、命中的工具名、实际 promoted 的工具名和 catalog hash。
- native-agent 之前无论 runtime 是否提供 details，都会在 `tool_execution_end.result` 中补一个空对象 `{}`，和“有结构化详情才带出”的语义不一致。

## 修改后补齐内容

- `packages/tools/src/types.ts`
  - `AgentToolResult.details` 改为可选字段。
  - 工具提供结构化元数据时进入统一追踪链路；未提供时不强行补空对象。

- `packages/tools/src/registry.ts`
  - `ToolRegistry` 在 dispatch result、`recordResult`、`onResult` 中透传 `details`。
  - 对所有工具返回的 `details` 做 JSON-safe 规范化和边界控制。
  - 屏蔽 token/password/secret/credential/cookie 等敏感字段。
  - 省略 stdout/stderr/raw request/raw response/prompt/content/text/body/input/output 等原文载荷字段。
  - 限制嵌套深度、对象键数、数组长度、单字符串长度和总字符串长度。
  - 对 Registry 内部路径补稳定错误码：
    - `INVALID_TOOL_ARGUMENTS`
    - `UNKNOWN_TOOL`
    - `TOOL_UNAVAILABLE`
    - `DEFERRED_TOOL_NOT_PROMOTED`
    - `TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED`
    - `REPEATED_TOOL_CALL`
    - `TOOL_LOOP_DETECTED`
  - batch supersede 结果记录 `supersededBy`，用于定位哪个 tool call 替代了当前调用。

- `packages/tools/src/deferred-tools.ts`
  - `tool_search` 增加结构化 `details`。
  - 记录 `query`、`catalogHash`、`matchedToolNames`、`promotedToolNames`。
  - 模型可见文本保持原行为：命中时返回完整工具 schema，未命中时返回未命中文本。

- `packages/tools/src/loop-guard.ts`
  - 循环保护 warning/stop 的结果同时进入 `content` 和 `details`。
  - `details` 中保留 `REPEATED_TOOL_CALL` / `TOOL_LOOP_DETECTED`、count/attempts、retryable 和 message。

- `packages/runtime-core/src/runtime.ts`
  - `ToolDispatchResult` 和 `tool_execution_end` 事件增加可选 `details`。
  - Runtime 在工具结束事件中继续带出 Registry 返回的结构化详情。

- `services/api/src/native-agent/index.ts`
  - native-agent 的 `tool_execution_end.result.details` 在 runtime 提供 details 时保留。
  - runtime 未提供 details 时不再补 `{}`。

- `services/api/src/native-agent/versioning.ts`
  - `ToolObservation` 保存 `details`，用于 versioning/CAS 侧问题溯源。

- `services/api/src/runs/index.ts`
  - 主 Agent 的 `tool.completed` trace 保留可克隆 `details`。
  - 子 Agent 的 `subagent.step` 保留可克隆工具 `details`。
  - `details` 克隆失败时尝试 JSON 往返降级，仍失败则省略，避免追踪字段打断 run event 处理。
  - 主 Agent / 子 Agent 的工具结束事件通过同一组装配 helper 生成 trace/step，单测覆盖实际装配路径。

- `packages/schema/src/session.ts`
  - `ToolTrace` 增加可选 `details`。

- `packages/schema/src/subagent.ts`
  - `SubagentStep` 增加可选 `details`。

## 具体工具覆盖

已对照源码盘点 Agent 可见工具入口，本 PR 通过 Registry/runtime/run 统一链路覆盖以下工具。

- 工作区与文件工具
  - `list_files`
  - `read_file`
  - `workspace_transfer`
  - `sync_remote_workspace`

- Artifact / provenance 工具
  - `get_file_provenance`
  - `list_artifacts`
  - `read_artifact`
  - `declare_artifact`
  - `trace_provenance`
  - `artifact_download`
  - `paper_extract_pdf`

- 执行、环境和 NPU 工具
  - `run_shell`
  - `execution_status`
  - `execution_logs`
  - `execution_cancel`
  - `environment_setup`
  - `run_npu_job`

- Web 和 Memory Graph 工具
  - `web_search`
  - `web_fetch`
  - `query_graph`
  - `declare_evidence`
  - `declare_claim`

- Subagent / Review / Skill 工具
  - `task`
  - `review_checkpoint`
  - `read_skill`
  - `read_skill_resource`
  - `create_skill`
  - `propose_skill_library_update`
  - `publish_skill_library_update`

- Plan / Evolve / Tool output 工具
  - `update_plan`
  - `read_tool_output`
  - `create_evolve_run`
  - `get_evolve_run`

- Timer 工具
  - `timer_create`
  - `timer_list`
  - `timer_cancel`

- 动态和框架级工具路径
  - 会话动态注入的 MCP tools，例如 `mcp__...`。
  - deferred tool discovery 的 `tool_search`。
  - Registry 内部生成的 supersede、参数错误、未知工具、能力策略禁用、deferred 拦截、循环保护、执行异常结果。

## 边界

- 沿用现有记录入口：run event、ToolTrace、SubagentStep、versioning/CAS、MCP invocation、Execution 记录、Artifact/provenance。
- 不新增 UI。
- 不新增独立审计文件、日志汇总文件、日志索引文件或日志 list 文件。
- 新增的 `details` 字段不复制用户会话正文、模型正文、报告正文、工具 stdout/stderr、MCP raw response 或文件内容原文。
- `ToolTrace.details` / `SubagentStep.details` 仍为 `unknown`，因为不同工具的结构化元数据形态不同；边界由 Registry sanitizer 和运行事件克隆降级保护。
- 大工具输出仍由现有 `ToolOutputGuard` 和 `read_tool_output` 处理。
- Shell stdout/stderr 仍由 Execution 记录和 `execution_logs` 读取。
- 既有 `content`、Execution、MCP invocation、CAS、Artifact 的保存语义不在本 PR 改动范围内。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #59

## 测试

- `.\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd -p packages/runtime-core/tsconfig.json`
- `.\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd -p packages/tools/tsconfig.json`
- `.\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd -p packages/schema/tsconfig.json`
- `.\node_modules\.bin\tsc.cmd -p services/api/tsconfig.json`
- `node --test packages/tools/dist/registry.test.js`：16/16 通过，覆盖工具失败 details、Registry 内部错误码、tool_search、supersede、循环保护、sanitizer 敏感字段省略、深度截断、循环引用、key/array 预算、非 object 根值包装和共享引用场景
- `node --test packages/runtime-core/dist/runtime.test.js services/api/dist/native-agent/native-agent.test.js`：47/47 通过，覆盖 runtime/native-agent details 透传，以及 native-agent 无 details 时不补空对象
- `node --test services/api/dist/runs/index.test.js`：11/11 通过，覆盖主 Agent `tool.completed` / 子 Agent `subagent.step` 的 `details` 装配路径和不可克隆降级

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

`switching to always-allow during a run stops asking for the tool calls that follow` 在 ut-host 上曾以光秃的 `1 !== 2`（`tool.completed` 计数）失败。该数字本身看不出是哪一次调用没完成、审批切换落在事件序列的哪里，本地也复现不出来。

本 PR **只改测试断言消息**，不修根因、不改生产代码：

- 失败时打印 SSE 按类型计数 + 有序事件类型序列（连续重复折叠）
- 同时打印 permission-authorizations 摘要（source / approvalMode / outcome / prompted|unprompted）
- 把授权列表的只读 GET 提前到第一个计数断言之前，使后续每条计数失败都能同时带上这两份证据

<!-- bot0-gitcode-native-export -->

Paired: [GitHub #14](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/14) ↔ [GitCode !112](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/112)

内网算力机器上的托管科学环境永远初始化不了，而且看不出为什么。Runner 自己去下载 micromamba 引导器，机器没有到发布站点的路由，于是失败；界面上只剩一行 `fetch failed`，Conda 组件停在 `pending`，唯一的建议是"重试"——在这种机器上重试永远是同样的结果。同一条错误原样抛给 Agent，`environment_list` 返回 `{"code":"TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED","message":"fetch failed","retryable":false}`，Agent 也无从判断是网络、证书还是权限。本 MR 修的是这两件事：让失败可诊断，并让部署 Runner 的控制面把机器自己拿不到的引导器送过去。关联 Issue [#78](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/issues/78)。

## 引导失败现在说得清是哪一步、为什么

Node 的 `fetch` 把所有传输失败都报成 `TypeError: fetch failed`，真实原因（DNS、连接被拒、TLS、超时）放在 `cause` 里，而这里只保留了 `error.message`，所以"主机不可达"和"代理坏了""证书过期"长得一模一样。

`installManagedMicromamba` 现在把失败分成三类，因为这三类要找的人和要做的事完全不同：

- `download`：报出目标 URL 与 `cause` 链里第一个有实质内容的原因（`ENOTFOUND`、`ECONNREFUSED`、HTTP 状态码、超时秒数）；
- `verify`：打印期望与实际 SHA-256——镜像服务了别的东西不是网络问题；
- `write`：打印路径与 errno——数据目录写不进去也不是网络问题。

`failSetup` 的建议随类别走，不再一律"重试"。同时新增 `SCIENCE_AGENT_MICROMAMBA_BASE_URL`，允许内网镜像托管同名发布件；**固定的 SHA-256 一律照校**，镜像能决定从哪里取，不能决定取到什么。

## 部署远程 Runner 时把引导器一起送过去

这些机器的常态是：带加速卡、在隔离网段、没有出口；而部署它们 Runner 的控制面有出口。所以 SSH 部署除了上传 Runner 自身的二进制，现在还按**远端机器的架构**取固定版本的 micromamba（x86_64 控制面给 aarch64 机器取 aarch64 的那一个），走与 Runner 二进制相同的流程：暂存 → 远端自校验 → 原子 `mv` 到位。

几条刻意的边界：

- 已经持有固定版本的机器只读一次校验和，不下载也不传输；
- 没有 `sha256sum` 的机器不写入任何东西，因为传输无法被验证；
- 控制面自己也取不到发布件时**不阻断连接**——能正常执行的连接不该因为一个可选便利被拒绝，Runner 会在自己的初始化状态里说明缺什么；
- 复用 Runner 自己的固定清单与安装器，不新增第二套下载与校验逻辑。

## 文档

`configuration.md` 两张变量表补上新变量；`runner-inheritance.md` 说明远程部署会带上引导器以及三条兜底路径；`network-proxy.md` 明确写出：引导下载**不**经过产品的代理策略（它发生在 Runner 进程内、Session 与模型策略之外），受支持的替代路径是控制面播种、镜像地址或机器上已有的 provisioner 路径。

## Validation

在待推送的提交上跑三层，宿主 Linux x86_64，bubblewrap 沙箱预检通过。

- **`pnpm ci:ut`**：除 `pnpm evolve:test` 外全部步骤 exit 0（install / uv sync gateway / uv sync paper / build / architecture:check / typecheck / ci:selftest / binary:test / 递归单测 / paper:test / gateway:test / memory-graph:test）。递归单测含 API、Web、Executor 等包全绿；gateway 53 pass / 0 fail，memory-graph 41 tests / 40 pass / 1 skipped。
  - `pnpm evolve:test` 失败 3 例：`test_measurement.py::test_a_real_candidate_runs_under_the_real_sandbox_and_is_scored`、`test_puct_end_to_end.py::test_a_real_search_improves_on_its_baseline`、`test_puct_sandbox.py::test_the_sandbox_blocks_the_writes_and_network_it_claims_to_block`。**已归因为既有问题**：在未修改的 `main`（`1ac04ca4`）上另起干净 worktree 跑同一层，失败的步骤与三条用例完全相同，错误文本一致。本 MR 不改 evolve 与沙箱，留给单独的变更处理。
- **`pnpm ci:st`**：exit 0，`Agent loop smoke PASS: first-step tools + native loop + streaming model transport + real tool round-trip + multi-turn history verified.`
- **`pnpm ci:e2e`**：见下节。
- 另外单独跑了本 MR 直接改到的两个包：Runner 237 tests / 232 pass / 0 fail / 5 skipped（既有 skip）；Executor 25 tests / 24 pass / 0 fail / 1 skipped，其中 6 条新用例覆盖播种路径——已持有固定版本只读校验和不传输、无 `sha256sum` 不写、不支持的架构连探测都不做、暂存→远端校验→原子 mv→清理暂存、缓存复用、被污染的缓存被拒。

## E2E user journeys

被测 SHA：`1114a573`（本 MR head）。

**旅程一（API + 本机产品栈，PASS）：内网 aarch64 机器的环境初始化。** 这正是 Issue #78 截图里的那台机器。

- 场景：该机器此前的 Runner 环境初始化停在 micromamba `failed` / `fetch failed`，Conda `pending`。用本 MR 的代码启动产品栈后，从设置里重新连接这台 Runner。
- 预期：机器自己不必下载引导器，环境初始化能走完。
- 实际：`POST /api/remote-hosts/<id>/runner/connect` → `state: ready`、`deployed: true`、`remoteVersion: 1114a573`；随后 `GET /api/remote-hosts/<id>/environment-setup` 依次给出 `micromamba=ready`（`provisioner: micromamba 2.8.1-0`、`managedProvisioner: true`）、`conda=installing / creating-python-base`，约一分钟后 `conda=ready`、`Conda environments are ready`；`GET .../environments` 返回 `starter-python`。也就是说，这台机器过不去的只有发布站点那一跳，播种之后整条链路自然走通。
- 启动与测试命令：`./scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local`，随后上述三个已鉴权 API 调用。

**旅程二（本机 Runner，PASS）：失败面的可诊断性。** 把 `SCIENCE_AGENT_MICROMAMBA_BASE_URL` 指向不可达主机复现原缺陷，`GET /environment-setup` 返回：

```
error : Could not download the micromamba provisioner from
        https://<unreachable-mirror>/micromamba-linux-64: ENOTFOUND
action: This machine could not reach the release. Either give it a route, point
        SCIENCE_AGENT_MICROMAMBA_BASE_URL at a mirror it can reach, or place the
        pinned micromamba at <runner data dir>/scientific-envs/bin/micromamba ...
```

随后把已校验的 micromamba 放到该托管路径（即控制面为远端机器所做的事）并重试，`micromamba` 转为 `ready`、`conda` 进入 `creating-python-base`。对照修复前：`fetch failed` + "重试"。

**浏览器层（`pnpm ci:e2e`，mocked 组）：未跑完，如实记为缺口。** 该层发现 21 条用例，执行到第 8 条时被我主动终止：这一层启动的隔离栈与操作者正在使用的本机实例绑定同一组固定端口（4310/4311/4313/17674），而 `start-stack.sh` 对 memory-graph 与 evolve 的健康检查写死在 `127.0.0.1:17674` 与 `:4313`，两个栈无法共存，我需要把那台实例还回去。已执行的 8 条中 7 条通过，1 条失败：`test/journey-custom-mcp.spec.ts:36 › Custom MCP and Inspector user journey`。该用例未做基线归因，因此**不声称**它是既有失败；本 MR 不触及 MCP 相关代码。这一层可以在本机空闲时补跑完整，或由流水线覆盖。

本 MR 不改任何 UI 行为，浏览器层作为回归执行；两条用户可观察路径（远程 Runner 连接后的环境初始化、失败时的诊断与指引）由上面两条旅程覆盖。

19.body:
<!-- bot0-gitcode-native-export -->

Paired: [GitHub #19](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/19) ↔ [GitCode !122](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/122)

关联 issue: #81

一个子智能体的流式文本，过去是**每收到一个 token 就把整条消息的累积快照写一次盘**，所以一次流的落盘体积是 O(N²)。实测一次两分钟的普通任务（下载两个 PDB 文件，8 次 `web_fetch` + 6 次 `run_shell`）写出了 **248,009,937 字节 / 25,495 行**，而这 25,495 行里只有 **34 个不同的 step id**，其中一个被重复写了 **7,636 次**；同一次运行的 `main.jsonl` 只有 0.1 MB / 198 行。读回来时更糟：首次追加触发的尾部恢复会把整份文件读进堆（`readFile` 之后再 `split`，堆里同时存在整串和行数组两份拷贝），于是 API 在**完全空闲、还没收到任何请求**的情况下，启动 33 秒后死于 `FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit`，原生栈顶是 `Runtime_StringSplit`，Mark-Compact 前后都是 1192.6 MB —— 一点都没回收出来，全是活跃引用。在把超大文件挪走之前，服务根本起不来。

## 写入侧：流式文本按间隔合并后再 emit

`services/api/src/runs/index.ts` 把 `publishStep` 拆成了 `recordStep`（只更新内存里的 `steps[]`）和 `flushMessageStep`（真正 emit）。流式的 assistant / thinking 文本只入队，每 `SUBAGENT_STREAM_EMIT_MS`（250 ms）把**最新的**快照 emit 一次，而不是每个 delta 都 emit。

事件形状没有变 —— 消费者拿到的仍然是整条内容的快照，所以前端和任何现有客户端都不需要改。顺序靠两处补 flush 来保证：`subagent.usage` 之前、以及拆除流程里（在清 `progressFlushTimer` 之前），确保最后一段文本一定先于用量事件和收尾事件落地。非流式的 step（工具调用等）仍然走原来的立即 emit 路径，它们本来就不是按 token 产生的。

这里有一个**可观察的行为变化**，我把它写进了断言而不是藏起来：一条由 2 个模型 delta 组成的回复，过去在 SSE 上产生 2 个 `subagent.step`，现在合并成 1 个。`server.test.ts` 里两处 golden 相应从 3 个 `subagent.step` 改成 2 个，并且**新增**了一条断言 —— 那唯一的一个 assistant step 必须携带完整文本 `"Subagent inspected the workspace and returned a concise result."`。这样以后谁把 flush 去掉，测试会立刻发现内容被截断，而不是只发现数量对不上。

## 读取侧：尾部恢复改成流式，不再整份读进堆

`services/api/src/store.ts` 的 `recoverStreamTail` 现在分两步：

1. `repairTornStreamTail(path)` —— 只读文件**末尾最多 8 MB**（`TORN_TAIL_SCAN_BYTES`）来找最后一个换行符，把可能写了一半的尾行截掉。这是原来整份读入唯一真正需要解决的问题，而它只关心文件末尾。
2. `streamLines(path)` —— 用 `handle.createReadStream` + `readline` 逐行读，配合从 `store/run-streams.ts` 里抽出来的单行解析函数 `parseStreamLine`。堆里任何时刻只有一行。

`parseStreamLines(content)` 保留原样给别的调用方用，只是改成复用 `parseStreamLine`，行为不变。

## 第三步：中间快照不再落盘

按 250 ms 合并只压下了常数，没改掉形状 —— 一条消息每个间隔仍然写一条累积快照，落盘体积照样随「内容长度 × 持续时间」增长。

但这些中间快照本来就是冗余的：刷新页面后能读回的在途文本，权威来源是 `enqueueProgressFlush` 每 250 ms 覆盖写的 Subagent 记录，**不是** `subagent-<id>` 这条流。所以每个间隔再往流里存一遍，只是把 catalog 已经有的东西重复了一次。

现在事件带一个投递模式：`transient` 的事件只发给在线订阅者，到此为止。定时器走的就是它，所以盯着子智能体打字的观感完全没变；而流里每个逻辑 step 只留一条记录，在消息结束时写入 —— 那次写了 25,495 行的运行，现在是 **34 条**。

`publishRunEvent` 给 transient 事件合成一条 `sequence: 0` 的广播记录（子流的广播副本本来就报 0），完全跳过 store。transient 事件仍然排在该 run 的事件队列上，所以在线观众不会在收到最终快照之后再收到一条过期的。

新增断言通过 API 把落盘的流读回来，要求没有任何 step id 出现两次，且存下来的 assistant step 携带完整消息。

## Validation

**UT（`pnpm ci:ut`）** 在 `packages/executor` 上失败：`not ok 25 - a generated key is a real OpenSSH key whose public half is what OpenSSH derives`，本机 `ssh-keygen -y` 不输出 comment 字段：

2.body:
Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the three existing test layers, and fixes a lockfile mismatch that currently makes all three of them fail before any test executes.

## `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

Three parallel jobs calling only the entry points already documented in `.ci/README.md`, so CI cannot drift into a second, GitHub-only test definition:

| Job | Command |
|---|---|
| UT | `pnpm ci:ut` |
| ST | `pnpm ci:st` |
| E2E (mocked) | `pnpm ci:e2e` |

Triggers on push to `main`/`master`, on pull requests, and manually. Only the hermetic layers are wired up — `ci:st:real`, `ci:e2e:real`, `ci:st:npu` and `ci:e2e:legacy` need credentials or hardware and stay behind their `CI_ALLOW_*` gates.

Three differences between a hosted runner and the `.ci` image had to be handled explicitly:

- **Result and runtime directories.** `run-layer.mjs` and `run-e2e.sh` default to `/ci-results` and `/ci-cache`, which exist only inside the `.ci` image. The jobs point `CI_RESULTS_DIR` into the workspace and `CI_RUNTIME_DIR` into the runner temp directory — deliberately outside the checkout, so the Runner sandbox never mounts over the data directory.
- **Sandbox capability.** `ut-runner` and the mocked journeys execute bubblewrap, and Chromium needs the same unprivileged user namespaces, which the Ubuntu 24.04 runner image denies by AppArmor policy. The jobs install bubblewrap, clear `kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns`, and run a `bwrap` preflight so a host policy problem fails as infrastructure instead of masquerading as a product failure.
- **Chromium cache**, keyed on `test/e2e.package-lock.json` — the file that pins the only Playwright version `run-e2e.sh` is allowed to install.

Every job uploads its `.ci-results/<layer>` directory on `always()`. For E2E that includes the Playwright report, `test-results` (traces and failure screenshots), the journey reports, and `stack.log` for attributing a stack-side failure.

One extra step, `Summarize the E2E outcome`, parses `test-results/results.json` and writes the passed/skipped/failed/flaky counts plus every not-passed title into the run summary. Playwright exits 0 on skips, so without it a run where J3 reports BLOCKED (`SCIENTIFIC_ENVS=0`) and the connector case skips looks indistinguishable from one where all seven journeys ran. It reports only and does not change the pass/fail verdict — turning a documented BLOCKED precondition into a red build is a policy decision, not something this PR should decide.

## Lockfile fix

`apps/web/package.json` declares `cytoscape`, `cytoscape-dagre` and `@types/cytoscape`, but `pnpm-lock.yaml` has no entry for any of them. Every `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` therefore aborts with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` — and that is the first command in all three layer entry points, and the default whenever `CI=1`:

```
[ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE] Cannot install with "frozen-lockfile" because
pnpm-lock.yaml is not up to date with <ROOT>/apps/web/package.json
* 3 dependencies were added: @types/cytoscape@^3.31.0, cytoscape@^3.34.0, cytoscape-dagre@^4.0.0
```

It reproduces locally with `CI=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; local development does not hit it because `node_modules` is already populated. Regenerated with `pnpm install --lockfile-only`; the diff is additive (+32 lines) and changes no existing resolution. Kept as a separate commit so it can be taken independently of the workflow.

Side note for whoever owns that dependency: `@types/cytoscape` is a deprecated stub — cytoscape ships its own type definitions.

## Validation

Executed on a fork before opening this PR, most recently on the rebased commit:

- UT — 1m46s; 382 api tests pass, memory-graph pytest 44 passed / 27 skipped
- ST — 36s; hermetic `run_m1_smoke.sh` round trip
- E2E (mocked) — 1m44s; 7 discovered, 5 passed, 2 skipped in 27.3s

The two skips are the documented ones: J3 (BLOCKED, no managed environments in the default run) and the connector case in `literature-review.spec.ts`.

One observation while reading the results: `.ci/README.md` states the mocked suite has a known J4 failure, where only the main artifact appears in the Project catalog. On this revision J4 passes and its journey report is PASS, so that paragraph looks stale and could be dropped or re-scoped.

关联 issue: #82

模型在推理，界面上一个字都没有 —— 整个推理阶段用户对着空屏幕等，直到正文开始才有东西出现。一台部署实例上最近几次运行的事件流里，`assistant.thinking.delta` 和 `assistant.thinking.snapshot` **一条都没有**，只有 `assistant.delta`。timeline 拿不到任何思考事件，自然没东西可渲染。

问题出在 `packages/model/src/client.ts` 的流式解析：推理字段是按方言门控的，只有 `deepseek` / `kimi-k3` / `qwen` / `minimax` 四个变体会读。其余方言下，`reasoning_content` 即使已经在流里收到了，也被静默丢弃。

触发它的配置是一个 DeepSeek 模型走火山 Ark 的 OpenAI 兼容端点：

```
apiProtocol  openai-chat-completions
apiVariant   openai                                        ← 这里
baseUrl      https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3
model        deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731
thinkingMode auto
```

Ark 按 DeepSeek 的格式在 `reasoning_content` 里流式返回思考，客户端因为变体对不上直接扔掉。这不是火山一家：SiliconFlow、vLLM 托管推理模型时同样在 plain OpenAI 方言下用这个字段。用户也没有理由知道"要把方言从 `openai` 改成 `deepseek` 才能看到思考"—— 这个选项的名字看起来是在描述**端点协议**，不是在描述**模型家族**。

## 兜底分支放在变体链末尾

任何方言只要吐了字符串 `reasoning_content`，就调 `onThinkingDelta` 显示出来。放在**最后**一个分支，所以已经声明了推理字段的变体，行为一个字都没变。

**只显示，不回放。** 历史里回写 `reasoning_content` 仍然按变体门控（`assistantMessage` 那段没动），因为那个 round-trip 是 DeepSeek 和 Kimi 契约的一部分；一个从没要过这个字段的端点，不应该在下一次请求里收到它。

顺带一个佐证：`thinkingMode` 为 `auto` 时，`chatThinkingFields` 对**所有**变体都返回空对象 —— `openai` 和 `deepseek` 两个变体发出去的请求体完全一样，差别只在响应解析这一侧。丢掉的是已经在网络上收到的数据，不是没请求过的数据。

新增用例 `a plain openai endpoint still shows reasoning_content without replaying it` 用 `apiVariant: "openai"` 跑一条带 `reasoning_content` 的流，断言三件事：思考 delta 按顺序到达、正文不受影响、`assistantMessage.reasoning_content` 保持 `undefined`（没有被回放）。

- **`packages/model`（本次唯一改动的包）**：`# tests 45 / pass 45 / fail 0 / skipped 0`，退出码 0，含新增的 `ok 4 - a plain openai endpoint still shows reasoning_content without replaying it`。

- **ST（`pnpm ci:st`）通过**：`Agent loop smoke PASS: first-step tools + native loop + streaming model transport + real tool round-trip + multi-turn history verified.`
- **UT（`pnpm ci:ut`）** 在 `packages/executor` 上失败：`not ok 25 - a generated key is a real OpenSSH key whose public half is what OpenSSH derives`（本机 `ssh-keygen -y` 不输出 comment 字段）。**已归因**：在未修改的 `main`（`6fa662af`）的独立 detached worktree 上跑同一层得到完全相同的失败，两边都是 `# tests 32 / pass 29 / fail 1 / skipped 2`。既有环境问题，与本改动无关。因为 pnpm 递归在第一个失败的包上就不再调度后续包，`packages/model` 在 `ci:ut` 里没跑到，所以上面单独跑了它。

## 问题

沙箱网络访问此前只有两种模式:`none`(完全无网络)和 `domain-allowlist`(仅白名单域名可出站)。对于需要沙箱代码访问任意端点的场景(如安装任意依赖、访问未预先列入白名单的数据源),管理员只能不断追加白名单,运维负担重。

## 方案

新增第三种模式 `open`:保留出站网关(egress gateway)架构不变 —— 沙箱仍无网络接口,所有出站流量仍经 runner 侧网关转发、仍全量审计日志 —— 仅跳过域名过滤:

- 任意主机可出站;私网地址过滤(回环/链路本地/RFC1918)默认仍然生效,可用 `allowPrivateNetwork` 显式开启
- IP 字面量目标在 `open` 模式下放行公网地址、拒绝私网地址(`domain-allowlist` 模式仍完全拒绝 IP 字面量)
- `open` 模式不接受 allowedDomains(配置时报错提示改用 domain-allowlist)
- 策略快照进 Permission Epoch,revision 随内容派生;mode 与 epoch 不一致的快照仍降级为无网络
- Web 管理界面新增 "Open network" 选项,选中时显示红色告警说明风险;私网开关在 none 模式外保持可用

## 变更范围

| 包 | 变更 |
|---|---|
| `@science-agent/schema` | `SANDBOX_NETWORK_MODES` 增加 `open`;类型与文档 |
| `services/api` | `normalizeSandboxNetworkSettings` 接受 `open` 并拒绝其携带 allowedDomains |
| `services/runner` | `EgressGateway.decide` 分流 `decideOpen`(跳过白名单、保留私网过滤);`EgressGatewayRegistry.acquire` 对非 `none` 模式提供网关;`sandboxNetworkCapability` 上报 `open` |
| `apps/web` | 模式选择、告警 UI、保存 toast 三分支文案、样式 |

## 验证

本地(基于 `origin/main` @ b8f189a 移植后):

- 沙箱网络相关单测 24/24 通过:
  - `services/api` `sandbox-network-settings` 5/5(含新增 "open mode snapshots into the epoch..." )
  - `services/runner` `egress-gateway` 10/10(含新增 "open mode allows any domain..."、"open mode passes IP literal targets..." )
  - `services/runner` `sandbox-network-contract` 9/9(含新增 "open is a valid sandbox network mode and round-trips through an epoch" )
- web 全量 361/361 通过(含新增 "open mode warns, keeps the private-address switch active and disables the domain list" )
- 同仓基线对照(无本改动)确认:`run-cancel` / `model-usage-api` 两个测试文件单独运行时进程不退出(全部子测试 ok 后挂起)是 `origin/main` 上已存在的行为,与本改动无关

## 安全边界

- 沙箱仍无网络接口;绕过网关 env 不产生第二条出路
- 私网地址过滤默认保留,防止探测部署自身内网
- 每条连接仍记审计日志
- UI 显式红色告警;`open` 模式与白名单互斥,不产生静默扩权

## 变更类型

/kind feature

## 背景

本 PR 补齐 Agent 工具调用的结构化追踪信息。目标是让 Agent 运行过程中各种工具的正常结果、业务失败、参数错误、策略拦截、循环保护和执行异常，都能通过现有运行记录链路定位到对应工具调用和错误详情。

这次不新增 UI，也不新增独立审计 JSONL、日志索引或日志 list 文件。

## 修改前情况

- 工具执行结果主要以模型可见的 `content` 文本进入 history / run stream；结构化元数据没有统一从工具层透传到 runtime、run trace、subagent step 和 versioning observation。
- 部分工具本身已经有独立记录，例如 Shell / Execution 的 stdout、stderr、状态和日志，MCP invocation、Artifact/provenance、CAS 等也已有各自存储；但 Agent run 事件里缺少统一的 `details` 线索，报错时需要靠文本内容或外部记录反查。
- Registry 内部产生的错误或控制结果，例如参数错误、未知工具、能力策略禁用、deferred tool 未提升、循环保护、batch supersede、工具抛异常，之前缺少稳定结构化 code，问题定位不够直接。
- `tool_search` 之前只返回模型可见文本，无法在 run trace 里看到 query、命中的工具名、实际 promoted 的工具名和 catalog hash。
- native-agent 之前无论 runtime 是否提供 details，都会在 `tool_execution_end.result` 中补一个空对象 `{}`，和“有结构化详情才带出”的语义不一致。

## 修改后补齐内容

- `packages/tools/src/types.ts`
  - `AgentToolResult.details` 改为可选字段。
  - 工具提供结构化元数据时进入统一追踪链路；未提供时不强行补空对象。

- `packages/tools/src/registry.ts`
  - `ToolRegistry` 在 dispatch result、`recordResult`、`onResult` 中透传 `details`。
  - 对所有工具返回的 `details` 做 JSON-safe 规范化和边界控制。
  - 屏蔽 token/password/secret/credential/cookie 等敏感字段。
  - 省略 stdout/stderr/raw request/raw response/prompt/content/text/body/input/output 等原文载荷字段。
  - 限制嵌套深度、对象键数、数组长度、单字符串长度和总字符串长度。
  - 对 Registry 内部路径补稳定错误码：
    - `INVALID_TOOL_ARGUMENTS`
    - `UNKNOWN_TOOL`
    - `TOOL_UNAVAILABLE`
    - `DEFERRED_TOOL_NOT_PROMOTED`
    - `TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED`

  - `ToolDispatchResult` 和 `tool_execution_end` 事件增加可选 `details`。
  - Runtime 在工具结束事件中继续带出 Registry 返回的结构化详情。

- `services/api/src/native-agent/index.ts`
  - native-agent 的 `tool_execution_end.result.details` 在 runtime 提供 details 时保留。
  - runtime 未提供 details 时不再补 `{}`。

  - `get_evolve_run`

  - Registry 内部生成的 supersede、参数错误、未知工具、能力策略禁用、deferred 拦截、循环保护、执行异常结果。

## 边界

- 沿用现有记录入口：run event、ToolTrace、SubagentStep、versioning/CAS、MCP invocation、Execution 记录、Artifact/provenance。
- 不新增 UI。

51.body:
The README is the first and often only page a visitor reads, and it was not doing the three jobs it should. It opened with a one-sentence pitch and then a security disclaimer, so the second thing a reader met was the caveats. The four feature bullets were dense prose that linked nowhere — not to a doc, not to a tutorial, not to a screenshot. "Installation" never said where to obtain a binary, which is exactly what openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery#1 asked. The Chinese `项目定位` section repeated the intro verbatim while the English one described the architecture, so the two languages answered different questions. And neither README mentioned the CLI at all, while the English deployment guide omitted the `run` command the Chinese guide documents.

This reworks both READMEs around what a first-time reader needs, and closes the English/Chinese gap in the deployment guide.

## Both READMEs, restructured

Centered header with badges and a navigation row, one screenshot of the workspace, then: what it is, install, first task, what you can do, command line, requirements, how it works, documentation, license. The two files now have identical structure and make identical claims.

The capability table replaces the prose bullets. Every row links to the page that documents it, so each claim is something a reader can go and check rather than something they have to take on faith.

**The security warning is kept verbatim** — same text, not softened. It moves below the getting-started path so it reads as scope rather than as the product's opening statement.

## Getting started actually ends somewhere

`Install` now finishes the job: after `serve`, it says to open **http://127.0.0.1:4310** and sign in with the printed token, and states plainly that the terminal window is just the service — the address is the product. A new **Configure a model** section then names the two screens involved, because "set a task model" alone does not tell anyone where the API key goes: **Model registry** for the provider, Base URL and API key, then **Global defaults** to select that model as the task model.

## Real download links

`Install` now links release 0.2.0 directly, with a copy-pasteable `curl` for x86_64 and the aarch64 asset beside it. Both asset URLs and the release page were checked and return 200.

## The CLI, introduced

Both READMEs gain a short `Command line` section, and `docs/en/how-to/deployment.md` gains the `run` subcommand section ported from the Chinese guide — the `run` line in the command list, the two-terminal example, the text/jsonl mode split, and the `--auto-approve` requirement for non-interactive runs. Those two rules are the ones a first scripted attempt fails on, so they are stated rather than left to `--help`.

## One deliberate omission, for a maintainer to decide

The "over 300 cross-domain Skills" figure is **not** carried over. It appeared only in the two READMEs — no source anywhere in the repository or the docs, while `skills/` ships 18. The capability is still described ("a cross-domain skill library"); only the unsourced number is gone. If the figure is one we stand behind, please restore it with a reference rather than taking my restatement as the final word — it is a marketing claim, not mine to adjudicate.

## Validation

Layers were run on `b87ca7bb` in a clean detached worktree of that commit. The pushed head `ead7cc6a` differs from it only in the two READMEs — the hero image reference, a Configure a model section, and the browser address after `serve` in the two READMEs — two markdown lines, no code — so the layer results carry over; the documentation checks below were re-run on `ead7cc6a`. Host is macOS (Darwin), which has no bubblewrap, so the two sandbox-dependent layers could not run here — stated below rather than substituted.

| Layer | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm ci:ut` | **Not runnable on this host.** Its guest tier executes a real bubblewrap sandbox, which does not exist on macOS. Ran `ci:ut:host` instead — not a substitute, reported as such. |
| `pnpm ci:ut:host` | **Failed at `pnpm ci:selftest`, on a pre-existing failure** (attribution below). Everything before it green: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `uv sync` for gateway and paper, `pnpm build`, `pnpm architecture:check` (8/8 tests, 275 package source files, "Architecture boundaries OK"), `pnpm typecheck`. Because the layer aborts at `ci:selftest`, the package tests and Python suites did not run on this host. |

52.body:
On a fresh host, `./scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local` printed exactly this and exited:

```
pnpm 11.1.2 is required.
```

No install command, no documentation pointer, and no mention of the three other dependencies the same run would have complained about on the next attempt. For researchers rather than Node developers that is a dead end — `uv` and `bubblewrap` are not tools they have met, and `bubblewrap` is not even the name the check looks for, since the package installs an executable called `bwrap`.

The binary launcher already does this properly: `missingBwrapMessage` in `services/launcher/src/preflight.ts` names what is missing, why it cannot be bundled, and the per-distribution install command. This brings source mode up to the same standard.

## What it prints now

The same host, unchanged except for this commit:

```
ScienceDiscovery cannot start from source: 3 host dependency problem(s).

  - Node.js 22.19+ is required for the control API and the runner, but no 'node' is on PATH.
    Install it with a version manager (nvm install 22) or your distribution's nodejs package.

  - pnpm 11.1.2 is required to install and build the workspace, but no 'pnpm' is on PATH.
    Enable it through the bundled corepack: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.1.2 --activate
    Or install it globally: npm install -g pnpm@11.1.2

  - uv 0.9+ is required to build the Python service environments, but no 'uv' is on PATH.
    Install it: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
    It is needed only for source mode; the prepackaged binary fetches its own.

  Requirements table: README.md#requirements
  Local source mode:  docs/en/how-to/deployment.md#local-mode-host-processes
```

## Decisions worth reviewing

**Collected, not fatal on sight.** A bare machine now learns everything it needs from one run instead of one failed start at a time. `require_command` records rather than exits, which keeps every call site a plain statement under `set -e`; `report_dependency_problems` is silent and returns 0 when nothing was collected, so a healthy host is completely unaffected.

**The bubblewrap entry names both strings.** "Install the bubblewrap package — the binary it provides is named bwrap", then the same per-distribution list the launcher prints, then the `SCIENCE_AGENT_BWRAP_PATH` escape hatch for an install that lives elsewhere. Naming only one of the two sends people searching for the wrong thing.

**The Seatbelt entry does not tell anyone to install anything**, because `sandbox-exec` ships with macOS. It says a miss usually means the current terminal or a parent sandbox is blocking it, and links the section of the deployment guide that covers it.

**The Node version gate keeps reporting what it found** (`found v20.11.0`) — that part was already right and is now routed through the same report. It is guarded by `command -v node` so a host with no Node at all reports the missing binary rather than a confusing version line.

## Validation

Layers run on `a3637b14` in a clean detached worktree. Host is macOS, which has no bubblewrap, so the two sandbox-dependent layers cannot run here.

| Layer | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm ci:st` | **Passed**, exit 0. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm build`, `bash test/api/run_m1_smoke.sh` → `Agent loop smoke PASS`. |
| `pnpm ci:ut` / `pnpm ci:e2e` | **Not runnable on this host** — both need a real bubblewrap sandbox, which does not exist on macOS. |
| `pnpm ci:ut:host` | Fails at `pnpm ci:selftest` on `.ci/auto-merge.test.mjs:358`, **pre-existing**: the identical failure reproduces on unmodified `c1ab6327` in a separate worktree. Unrelated to this change; belongs in its own merge request. |

Script-level checks, all run against the edited file:

- `bash -n scripts/start-stack.sh` — clean.
- **Missing node/pnpm/uv** (`PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`): the report above, exit code 1.
- **Missing bubblewrap** (`SCIENCE_AGENT_SANDBOX_PROVIDER=bubblewrap` on a host without it): the bubblewrap entry with all five distribution commands and the `SCIENCE_AGENT_BWRAP_PATH` hint.
- **Missing Seatbelt** (`SCIENCE_AGENT_SEATBELT_PATH=/nonexistent/sandbox-exec`): the "ships with macOS" entry and the doc link.
- **Helpers in isolation** (extracted from the file and sourced under `set -euo pipefail`): empty state returns 0 and prints nothing; a present command records nothing; a missing command records one entry with its multi-line remedy intact; the report then exits non-zero.
- Both referenced anchors resolve — `README.md#requirements` and `docs/en/how-to/deployment.md#local-mode-host-processes`.

## E2E user journeys

**Not applicable as a browser journey, with the CLI path exercised directly.** The only user-observable change is the text a failed source-mode start prints; there is no UI, API or Run behaviour involved. The four failure paths above were driven through the real entry point (`bash scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local`) and their output is quoted verbatim, which is the journey for this change.

`scripts/start-stack.sh` is also the entry point behind `.ci/run-e2e.sh` and `scripts/docker-entrypoint.sh`. Its interface, arguments and success path are unchanged — the preflight is silent and returns 0 when every dependency is present, verified in isolation above — but note that `pnpm ci:e2e` itself could not be run on this macOS host, so that is stated rather than claimed.

53.body:
The web UI ships a 2442-key message catalogue and a language switch, and the Idea Tree feature ignored both: forty-five user-visible strings were Chinese literals written straight into JSX. `detectLocale()` returns `en` for any browser whose `navigator.languages` do not start with `zh`, so this was the **default** path rather than an edge case.

What made it jarring rather than merely untranslated is that the other half of the same feature *was* translated — `ideaTree.phase.building_tree`, `ideaTree.maxDepth` and friends all live in the catalogue. An English reader got "Building Idea Tree" and "Max depth" sitting beside 暂停, 继续 and 第 1 / 5 轮 in one panel.

## Idea Tree moved into the catalogue

| File | Strings |
|---|---|
| `IdeaResearchCard.tsx` | 14 |
| `IdeaResearchLabels.ts` | 11 |
| `IdeaTreeSettingsEditor.tsx` | 9 |
| `IdeaTreeExplorer.tsx` | 5 |
| `IdeaResearchTimelineCard.tsx` | 5 |
| `IdeaTreeView.tsx`, `IdeaTreeCanvas.tsx` | 1 each |

That includes the status maps that were built as object literals at the call site — `{running: "执行中", completed: "已完成", …}[activity.status]` appeared in two components — which are now lookup tables of message keys with a documented fallback.

**`IdeaResearchLabels` takes the caller's `t`** instead of reading the module-level active locale. `LocaleProvider` sets that module value from an effect, which runs *after* render, so a label read from it would be one render stale on a language switch. Passing `t` in costs one argument and removes the question.

Unknown statuses and roles still fall through to the raw token: the engine can report a value this build does not know, and showing `some_new_phase` beats showing nothing.

## Two code paths that ran their own translation mechanism

`plugins/settings.tsx` had eight `zh ? "…" : "…"` ternaries plus per-entry `zh` / `descriptionZh` fields on the plugin manifest table — a second translation system running beside the catalogue, where new strings land in whichever one the author happens to touch. It now uses keys like everything else.

Implementing that turned up a second instance the issue had not found:

```
App.tsx: locale.startsWith("zh") ? (… ? "对话" : "轨迹") : (… ? "Conversation" : "Trajectory")
```

Also converted.

## What I deliberately did **not** change

The issue listed the whole `node.relation.*` set as untranslated. It is identical in both catalogues on purpose: `produces`, `stated_in` and `extracts` are Neo4j relationship type names, and `docs/zh/explanation/science-memory.md` uses them untranslated as identifiers — "由 `next` 时序边与 `produces` 产出边串起来". Translating them in the UI would break the correspondence between a graph edge, the documentation, and the Cypher. Same reasoning for the product terms `Skills`, `Runner`, `SubAgent` and `Epoch`, which the Chinese docs and catalogue treat as loanwords. I left a correction on the issue.

Three entries in that list *were* a real gap — Idea Tree prompt labels sitting in English against their own neighbours' house style, which keeps the English role name and translates the surrounding noun (`"Activity 评估器"`, `"PROPAGATE 指令"`). They now read `"Designer 提示词"`, `"Assessor 系统提示词"` and `"Aggregator 提示词"`.

## Tests

The two tests that asserted the hardcoded Chinese were asserting the bug. They now render through `LocaleProvider` in **both** locales and assert each — the English render additionally asserts that no CJK character survives — so a regression fails the build instead of passing in one language.

## Validation

Tested SHA `48dab409`, in a clean detached worktree. Host is macOS, which has no bubblewrap.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web typecheck` | **Clean.** |
| `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web test` | **735 tests, 735 pass, 0 fail** — identical to unmodified `c1ab6327` (735/735), run in a separate worktree for comparison. This is the package the change touches. |
| `pnpm ci:st` | **Passed**, exit 0. install, build, `test/api/run_m1_smoke.sh` → `Agent loop smoke PASS`. |
| `pnpm architecture:check` | **Passed** — 8/8, 275 package source files, "Architecture boundaries OK". |
| `pnpm ci:ut` / `pnpm ci:e2e` | **Not runnable on this host** — both need a real bubblewrap sandbox. |

Two suites outside `apps/web` fail on this host. Both are **pre-existing and platform-dependent**, and the diff touches nothing they cover:

- `pnpm binary:test` — 41 tests, 34 pass, **6 fail** in `scripts/binary-release/codearts-build-dispatch.test.mjs`. The identical six fail on unmodified `c1ab6327` (40/33/7 there, the extra one a flaky `runner-sea.test.mjs`).
- `services/launcher` — `tar-extract.test.js`, "extracts a gnu archive with long names, modes and symlinks". A GNU-tar test on a BSD-tar host.

Linux CI is the authority on both; they are reported rather than claimed green.

### Counting check

- Hardcoded CJK string literals in `apps/web/src/**` outside `i18n/` and outside comments: **45 before, 0 after.**
- Catalogue parity: **2519 English keys, 2518 Chinese** — the only absentee is `test.englishFallback`, a fixture that exists to prove the English fallback path, unchanged by this work.

## E2E user journeys

**Browser journey not run on this host** — `pnpm ci:e2e` needs bubblewrap, which macOS does not have, so this is reported as a gap rather than a pass.

The user-observable behaviour is covered at the component level instead, in both directions and in the real render path: `IdeaTreeExplorer` and `RunTimeline` are rendered through `LocaleProvider` at `en` and at `zh-CN`, asserting the English strings appear (and that no CJK character survives the English render) and that the Chinese strings appear under `zh-CN`. Before this change the English render contained 综合评估 and "Idea Tree 研究已启动"; it now contains "Overall assessment" and "Idea Tree research started".

Scenario → expected → actual, at `initialLocale: "en"`:

| Scenario | Expected | Actual |
|---|---|---|
| Idea Tree explorer, autonomous research with an aggregate stage | Assessor heading in English | `Overall assessment`, no CJK anywhere in the render |
| Conversation timeline with an `idea_research.created` event | Card in English | `Idea Tree research started` |
| Same two, at `initialLocale: "zh-CN"` | Chinese preserved | `综合评估`, `Idea Tree 研究已启动` |

`/evolve` is one of the largest features in the product and had no user documentation in either language. A researcher could not learn what a search is for, when scoring will actually discriminate, or how to start one, without reading the source.

What ships: a 23-module Python sidecar, two search engines, four scoring modes, two agent tools, a design skill, 13 web components, 188 `evolve.*` message keys, four HTTP endpoints. What was documented: **one** Chinese file — `explanation/evolve-standalone.md` — which no index linked, and which answers a maintainer's question (how the two engines differ, what it would take to run the sidecar standalone). In English, "evolve" appeared in exactly one file, in passing.

## Six new pages

| | English | Chinese |
|---|---|---|
| Explanation | `explanation/evolve.md` | `explanation/evolve.md` |
| How-to | `how-to/run-an-evolution-search.md` | `how-to/run-an-evolution-search.md` |
| Tutorial | `tutorial/02-evolve-a-solution.md` | `tutorial/02-evolve-a-solution.md` |

**The explanation** leads with the one property everything rests on — the scoring has to separate a good candidate from a bad one, and scoring that cannot does not raise an error, it produces a flat run — then covers the four scoring modes with the case each suits, the two engines, the rollout/gate/test split, the discrimination probe, the frozen scorer, where candidates execute, and when *not* to run a search.

**The how-to** is the operational path: proposing a search, the four design checkpoints, shard sizing with the numbers that matter, choosing a seed, reading the panel, and a table of what to do when a run goes wrong (flat run, many candidates failing to start, nothing beating the seed, gate far above test).

**The tutorial** is one compression search a reader can complete in about fifteen minutes, with what to look at at each checkpoint and how to tell a real improvement from a fitted one.

## The guidance is taken from the code, not invented

Where the repository already states something better than I could, this quotes it rather than paraphrasing:

- the seed measurements from `skills/evolve-design/SKILL.md` — a cache task seeded with a working LRU climbing 0.2218 → 0.9396, against a compression task seeded with identity encoding which spent ten expansions on from-scratch compressors, seven of which did not run, and finished at 0.226;
- the gate/rollout/test sizing bands, including why a unit holding a single item quietly costs expansions;
- the upstream note on the frozen scorer: *without it the shortest path to a high score is to weaken the thing measuring it.*

The three-way shard split, the four-evaluation discrimination probe, the repair loop, the run-scoped ephemeral token and the `era` → `puct` rename all come from the merge requests that built the feature and from the domain modules themselves.

## Screenshots

Eight images from the two merge requests that built the feature — !55 (PUCT) and !79 (OpenEvolve) — **committed under `docs/images/evolve/`** rather than hot-linked, so the documentation does not depend on an external asset host. 2.8 MB total.

They are used where they explain something rather than decorating: the algorithm picker where the engines are compared, the live panel where the score chart is described, the island grid where MAP-Elites is introduced, the version diff where the result is described, and the memory-graph node where the ScienceMemory mirror is mentioned.

## Fixing what was already there

- `evolve-standalone.md` is now linked from the Chinese explanation index. That takes the repository's orphan pages from three to two (`docs/architecture/runtime-core.md` and `docs/zh/explanation/idea-tree-engine.md` remain, out of scope here).
- A pointer at its top routes a reader who lands on it to the new user-facing pages, since its own title already scopes it correctly as the engine-internals and standalone-deployment note.
- The four evolve endpoints are added to both REST API references, and the two agent tools to both built-in tool references — including the fact that `get_evolve_run` is not a waiting mechanism.

## Not in this PR

An English translation of `evolve-standalone.md`. It is 252 lines of maintainer-facing engine internals, and the new explanation page now covers what a user needs in both languages; translating the internals note is worth its own change. [#55](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/55) lists it, so the issue should stay open for that item.

## Validation

Documentation-only: 23 files, 739 insertions, no code touched.

- **Relative-link check across the repository**: 85 markdown files (all of `docs/` plus `README.md`, `README_zh.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) — **0 dead links**, including every new cross-reference and all eight image paths.
- **Orphan check**: every new page is reachable from its index; repository orphans reduced from 3 to 2.
- **Image check**: all eight committed images are referenced by at least one page; none is unused.
- **Structural parity**: the English and Chinese sets have the same three pages, the same section structure, and the same claims.
- `pnpm ci:st` — **passed**, exit 0 (`Agent loop smoke PASS`), confirming the tree is unaffected.
- `pnpm ci:ut` / `pnpm ci:e2e` — **not runnable on this macOS host**, which has no bubblewrap; stated rather than claimed.

## E2E user journeys

**Not applicable.** The diff adds documentation and images; no product code, UI, API or CLI behaviour changes, so there is no user journey whose outcome differs before and after. The link, orphan, image and parity checks above are the equivalent coverage. This does not turn the two unrun CI layers into passes — they are reported as not runnable above.

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

新机器上跑 `./scripts/start-stack.sh --mode local`，全部输出就是这一行然后退出：

二进制启动器早就把这件事做对了：`services/launcher/src/preflight.ts` 的 `missingBwrapMessage` 会说明缺什么、为什么不能内置、以及各发行版的安装命令。本 PR 让源码模式追平同一标准。

改后同一台机器的输出：

```
ScienceDiscovery cannot start from source: 3 host dependency problem(s).

  - Node.js 22.19+ is required for the control API and the runner, but no 'node' is on PATH.
    Install it with a version manager (nvm install 22) or your distribution's nodejs package.

  - pnpm 11.1.2 is required to install and build the workspace, but no 'pnpm' is on PATH.
    Enable it through the bundled corepack: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.1.2 --activate
    Or install it globally: npm install -g pnpm@11.1.2

  - uv 0.9+ is required to build the Python service environments, but no 'uv' is on PATH.
```

**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

---

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

`services/api` 的 `reviewer-specialist/audit-coordinator` 测试套件会间歇性地让 `UT / host tier` 失败，与被测分支的业务改动无关。本 PR 消除该套件的竞态，并顺带修掉一处会话消息文件的非原子写。

**CI 上观察到的失败**

```
not ok 375 - a generated Artifact registered while drain is exiting schedules a new wakeup
  failureType: 'hookFailed'
  error: "ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty, rmdir '.../.tmp/reviewer-exit-wakeup-<ts>-<pid>/reviewer-audit-tasks'"
```

断言体已经通过，失败发生在 `context.after` 的清理钩子上。本地循环跑该文件还能复现第二种形态：`Unexpected end of JSON input`。两者合计约每 5 次跑出 1 次失败。

**根因**

两种形态同源：每个用例都通过**某一条已持久化的记录**来观察后台 `drain`，然后就结束用例；但它等待的那条记录并不总是 `drain` 的**最后一次写**。于是 teardown 和后续读取与仍在进行的写并发。

具体有四处信号取错：

- exit-wakeup 用例等的是 executor stub 内部自增的计数器，它在 `drain` 落盘任何任务状态**之前**就已经到达；
- 失败路径先落任务终态、**之后**才修复 checkpoint，所以随后读 checkpoint 的用例可能读得太早；
- skipped 路径先落任务终态、**之后**才删除临时 checkpoint；而"消息列表为空"这一条件在卡片还没发布时**本来就成立**，因此该处必须同时满足两个条件；
- 共享通道用例把等待锚在某一个 Session 上，但两次 enqueue 各自调度自己的 `drain`，谁抢到进程级 automatic 通道是不确定的；一旦另一个抢到并停在 gate 上，等待就死锁。

**改动**

- 每处等待改为观察**该路径最后写的东西**；
- 共享通道用例改为断言它名字所声明的不变量——同一时刻恰好一个 automatic 任务在跑——不再假定顺序；
- teardown 的递归删除加 `maxRetries`，这正是 Node 为 `EBUSY/ENOTEMPTY` 这类错误提供的重试语义；
- `waitFor` 上限 1s → 5s。所有调用都是"条件成立即返回"，上限只约束失败情形；"什么都没跑"的反向校验用的是显式 sleep，不受影响。

**顺带修复：会话消息文件原子写**

`getSessionDetail` / `readMessages` 会在后台改写该文件时解析它（reviewer 审核落 checkpoint 就足以触发）。原来这些写用的是裸 `writeFile`，它先截断再写，并发读者可能读到半个文件。现在统一走 store 里已有的 `writeArray`（临时文件 + rename），与 store 其余数组状态一致；同时也让写入过程中崩溃不再截断文件。

---

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

无对应 Issue。

---

**Test Plan and Test result：What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

base `origin/main` `ea4a0e095f914f5b75ee14d16a48fa6c231ef9af`，1 commit。

| --- | --- | --- |
| `audit-coordinator.test.js` 连续跑 | 约每 5 次 1 次失败（ENOTEMPTY / Unexpected end of JSON input） | **80 次连续全绿** |
| `services/api` 全套件 | — | 多次运行结果稳定，该文件不再出现在失败列表 |
| workspace `pnpm typecheck` | — | 0 错误 |

- `explicit PDF extraction persists lifecycle and is idempotent after completion`、`PDF upload extracts full text and tables into the session workspace`：`spawn services/paper/.venv/bin/python ENOENT`，本地未初始化 paper venv，属环境缺失；

真正刺眼的是同一功能的另一半**是翻译过的** —— `ideaTree.phase.building_tree`、`ideaTree.maxDepth` 等都在目录里。英文读者看到的是 "Building Idea Tree" 和 "Max depth" 与 暂停、继续、第 1 / 5 轮 并排出现在同一个面板里。

**Idea Tree 全部进目录**：

| 文件 | 处数 |
|---|---|
| `IdeaResearchCard.tsx` | 14 |
| `IdeaResearchLabels.ts` | 11 |
| `IdeaTreeSettingsEditor.tsx` | 9 |
| `IdeaTreeExplorer.tsx` | 5 |
| `IdeaResearchTimelineCard.tsx` | 5 |
| `IdeaTreeView.tsx`、`IdeaTreeCanvas.tsx` | 各 1 |

包含在调用点以对象字面量构造的状态映射 —— `{running: "执行中", completed: "已完成", …}[activity.status]` 在两个组件里各出现一次 —— 现改为消息键查表并带明确回退。

**`IdeaResearchLabels` 改为接收调用方的 `t`**，而不是读模块级 active locale。`LocaleProvider` 是在 effect 里同步那个值的，effect 在渲染之后执行，所以从它读到的标签在切换语言后会慢一帧。传入 `t` 只多一个参数，且不再有这个问题。未知状态与角色仍回退为原始 token：引擎可能报出本版本不认识的值，显示 `some_new_phase` 好过什么都不显示。

**两处自建的第二套翻译机制**：`plugins/settings.tsx` 的 8 处 `zh ? "…" : "…"` 三元，外加插件清单表上的 `zh` / `descriptionZh` 字段 —— 与 2442 条目录并行运行，新字符串落在作者恰好碰到的那一套里。实现过程中还发现 issue 未提到的第二处：`App.tsx` 的 `locale.startsWith("zh") ? (… ? "对话" : "轨迹") : (…)`。两处现均走目录。

**刻意未改**：`node.relation.*` 整组。它们在中英目录中相同是有意的 —— `produces`、`stated_in`、`extracts` 是 Neo4j 关系类型名，中文科学记忆文档正是把它们当标识符使用（"由 `next` 时序边与 `produces` 产出边串起来"）。在界面里翻译会切断图谱边、文档与 Cypher 三者的对应。同理保留 `Skills`、`Runner`、`SubAgent`、`Epoch` 等外来语。已在对应 issue 上留更正说明。

该组里确有三条是真漏译 —— Idea Tree 的提示词标签与邻居的行文风格不一致（邻居是 "Activity 评估器"、"PROPAGATE 指令"），现改为 "Designer 提示词"、"Assessor 系统提示词"、"Aggregator 提示词"。

---

对应镜像仓 issue openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery#28。

1. **交付即已读**：Agent 工具绑定层在 `start` / `wait` / `get` / `list` / `cancel` 以及 `logs` 对应记录返回终态时，按 `(owner, sourceId)` 把完成通知标为已读。仍在 `queued` / `running` 的记录不标，因此 `background: true`、wait 用尽、定时器继续唤醒。人类面板路由不经过这层，不会替模型消费通知。

---

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**：

在 Ascend 910B 上，主机 `npu-smi` 可以把每张卡都报成健康，但 bubblewrap 沙箱经常打不开其中一部分。把宿主 `/dev` 整棵绑进沙箱时，驱动会一次枚举所有卡；只要有一张当时占不上，整次启动失败。操作员既看不到哪些卡真正能在沙箱里打开，也无法只把能用的卡交给一次执行。

本改动对每张 910B 卡用一次性沙箱做探针，在远程计算的 Runner 卡片上展示状态和占用，只允许勾选探针通过的卡。勾选的卡绑到全新 `/dev` 上并从 0 编号。`npu-smi info` 和框架代码走与普通工具相同的隔离。既有宿主 NPU Broker 不改。设计和取舍见 #9。

---

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**：

Fixes #​75 (#9)

---

**Test Plan and Test result：What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

### 探针、勾选与沙箱绑定

- 每张卡的探针与正式启动使用同一套 namespace、`--cap-drop ALL`、全新 `--dev /dev`。打不开的卡保留驱动原文，不能勾选（保存时 409）。
- 启动前再校验勾选。卡事后被占时，按卡号失败，而不是掉进框架内部。
- 绑定方式：`--dev /dev` 再逐卡 `--dev-bind`。隔离参数未放宽。
- 有 NPU 时 PATH 才加上 `/usr/local/bin`，以便找到 `npu-smi`；无 NPU 时 PATH 不变。
- 保存勾选时向 Runner 要现场清单，不读从未落盘的连接态（否则远程勾选会全部 409）。
- 执行签名窗口仍默认 30 秒。加宽只能设 `SCIENCE_AGENT_EXECUTION_SIGNATURE_MAX_AGE_MS`。

### 验证（提交 `e2c5090d`，基线 `origin/main` `ea4a0e09`）

本机三层（`bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev true` 已通过）：

| `pnpm ci:ut` | 构建、架构检查、类型检查、selftest、binary、paper、gateway、memory-graph 通过。递归包测：web **631 pass**，API **788 pass / 1 skipped**。`pnpm evolve:test` **3 个失败**（`test_measurement.py`、`test_puct_end_to_end.py`、`test_puct_sandbox.py`）。未改的 `origin/main` 上同样三个失败、同样报错。不是本改动引入的。 |

| `pnpm ci:st` | **通过** — `test/api/run_m1_smoke.sh` Agent 循环冒烟 |
| `pnpm ci:e2e` | mocked **17 passed / 2 failed / 2 skipped**。新增旅程 **J7 NPU 卡片 PASS**（7/7）。失败项：J6 模型设置删除文案；F1 远程 Runner 窄屏布局。两者都不断言 NPU 勾选。J6 与本改动无关。F1 未注入 NPU 清单（选择器不渲染）。 |

被测 SHA：`e2c5090d`。总判定：**PASS**（J7 与 910B 沙箱 `npu-smi`）；MindSpore/torch-npu 在本轮产品 `run_shell` 中为覆盖缺口。

镜像上的 GitHub Actions 在 `cee1974d` 上 E2E (mocked) 变红：4 条旅程失败，整个 job 跑了 16.6 分钟。UT、ST 和两个 binary job 都是绿的。四条失败是两个根因，但属于同一类问题——**界面文案从组件里的硬编码中文搬进了消息目录，而旅程还按旧文本找元素**。旅程因此找不到元素，并且大多以「耗尽用例预算」的形式超时，失败点落在 timeout 上，读起来完全不像文案问题。本 PR 只改 4 个 Playwright 旅程文件，不动产品代码。

## 跟进服务商编辑器凭据字段的改名

本地令牌登录那轮改动把服务商编辑器里的凭据字段从「LLM API 令牌」改成「外部模型 API Key」（英文 `External model API Key`）。这是有意为之：要让**模型服务商的 key** 和**本地服务访问令牌**在界面上分得开。那次改动新增的 `journey-local-token-onboarding` 用的是新文案，但三条既有旅程没跟着改。

判别点在失败链路本身：

```
waiting for getByRole('dialog', { name: '系统设置' })
  .getByRole('region', { name: '服务商编辑器' })
  .getByLabel('LLM API 令牌')
```

链路上的 `服务商编辑器`、`服务商名称` 都能解析，说明页面确实是中文，只有这一个 label 找不到——所以不是语言问题，是字段改名。

三条旅程表现不同，源头相同：

- `journey-model-settings`：`toBeVisible` 直接判失败（10 s）。
- `journey-first-run`、`journey-provider-model-catalog`：卡在 `fill` 上，各自把 3 分钟、4 分钟的用例预算耗光——这也是这个 job 跑满 16.6 分钟的原因。

三个文件共 9 处调用改用新文案。它们都有 `test.use({ locale: "zh-CN" })`，所以取中文那条；其他断言一处未动。

## 让 Idea Tree 旅程声明自己的语言

`journey-idea-tree-fixture` 从头到尾按中文读研究界面，却从没声明过这一点。文案硬编码在组件里的时候这没问题——无论什么 locale 都渲染中文。现在这些文案都进了消息目录，而 Playwright 给 Chromium 的默认 locale 是 `en-US`，`detectLocale()` 于是选 `en`，页面渲染英文：

```
waiting for getByRole('dialog', { name: /System configuration|系统设置/ })
  .locator('.idea-tree-settings').getByLabel('科研模板')
```

第一个下拉就没解析出来，整条旅程耗尽 180 s。它后面的中文定位其实同样已经暴露在外：`ideaResearch.controlsAria`、`progressAria`、`viewProgress`、暂停/继续/结束控件和全部状态词现在都来自消息目录，只是超时发生在前面、没跑到那里。

加 `test.use({ locale: "zh-CN" })` 一次覆盖全部，也与 `journey-first-run`、`journey-model-settings`、`journey-provider-model-catalog` 已有的做法一致。旅程选择的 option 值（`water-treatment-materials/v1`、`standard`）与语言无关，未作改动。

三层全部在待合入的内容上本机跑过，均为退出码 0。三次运行记录的提交是 `1a353b3f`，
本 MR 随后按社区约定压成单提交 `2856f564`；两者的 tree 完全相同（`3af29513189055aff28b033cac2a858d0a7260bb`），即验证覆盖的内容与当前 head 一致。宿主沙箱可用（`bwrap --ro-bind / / --dev /dev true` 通过）。

## E2E user journeys

**结论：PASS。** 被测 SHA `1a353b3f53ea7297d15eb6d03ef52039c9e08ed7`（压缩前；与当前 head `2856f564` 内容一致，见上）。接口：浏览器（项目固定的 Playwright mocked 分组，隔离栈）。

两条 skipped 是既有的条件跳过，与本改动无关，也不是通过：

Fixes openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery#23.

ScienceMemory recorded nothing until the user installed and ran a Neo4j 5.x server. That is a heavy prerequisite for a small per-session graph, and impossible on offline, rootless or container-less hosts. This adds a Neo4j-free backend that keeps the graph as plain text files, makes it the default, and keeps Neo4j as an explicit choice for larger or shared deployments.

## Local file backend

- `local_graph.py`: an in-memory property graph persisted as append-only JSONL (`nodes.jsonl`, `edges.jsonl`) under `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_DATA_DIR` (default `~/.science-agent/memory-graph`). Replay is last-write-wins per id, a torn last line is skipped, and files compact on load. Mutators journal an undo log, so a failed statement or a rolled-back transaction leaves no partial writes.
- `_cypher.py`: a small openCypher interpreter covering exactly the subset the service issues (MATCH / OPTIONAL MATCH, WITH, UNWIND, MERGE with ON CREATE / ON MATCH, CREATE, SET, DELETE, UNION, CALL subqueries, FOREACH, variable-length paths, aggregation, CASE, reduce). I chose this over reimplementing ~240 statements in `persistence`, `query` and `search_graph`, so those modules run unchanged on either backend and their behaviour cannot drift apart. Schema DDL is a no-op; uniqueness comes from the MERGE keys.
- One store holds all sessions; every node keeps its `session_id`.

## Backend selection is a setting

- `backend.py` adds the `GraphBackend` seam and a router. The backend is `System configuration → Memory → Storage backend`, default **Local files**. Choosing **Neo4j server** reveals the Neo4j HTTP address, user and password fields.
- The API pushes the choice to a new `POST /internal/backend` (at startup when Neo4j is selected, and on every change). The Memory settings GET re-pushes it if a restarted sidecar fell back to `local`.
- A saved Neo4j credential alone never switches stores, and a selected but unreachable Neo4j stays `degraded` rather than silently falling back, so the two histories never diverge.
- `/health` now returns `{"status": "healthy", "backend": "local"}` with no setup.

## Migration

`python -m sciencediscovery_memory_graph.export_to_neo4j` copies the local store into Neo4j (one-way, idempotent, MERGE on a temporary `_local_id`). **Not exercised against a live Neo4j**, because none was available here.

## Docs

`docs/{en,zh}/how-to/science-memory-setup.md` gain a zero-setup section and describe the Storage backend field.

## Validation

Run on the pushed commit on macOS:

- memory-graph pytest, default (Neo4j-pinned) mode: 91 passed, 77 skipped (the live-Neo4j cases).
- memory-graph pytest with `SCIENCE_AGENT_MEMORY_GRAPH_TEST_BACKEND=local`: 167 passed, 1 skipped. This runs the existing live-Neo4j suites (`test_smoke`, `test_upsert_tool_call`, `test_webpage_*`) against the local backend, which is the conformance check for the interpreter. The one skip asserts Neo4j server-side constraints.
- web: 786 passed, 0 failed. schema, memory, api and web `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- api `store.test`: memory-graph tests 3/3 passed. api `server.test`: 86 passed, **1 failed**: `API runs a configured OpenAI-compatible model through the gateway and Python`. It does not touch the memory graph and I did not confirm it against a clean `main`, so I am not claiming it is pre-existing.

**Not run: `pnpm ci:ut`, `pnpm ci:st`, `pnpm ci:e2e`.** This host is macOS and has no `bwrap`, which `ci:ut` and `ci:e2e` require, so the CI gates are unrun. Please read the CodeArts result on this merge request for `ut` and `st`.

## E2E user journeys

**BLOCKED.** I did not drive the real product path (start the stack, open System configuration → Memory, run a task, open the ScienceMemory graph) on this host. What I did verify is the sidecar HTTP contract through FastAPI's TestClient, including `/health`, `/internal/backend` and the evidence / claim / artifact-chain endpoints on the local backend. That is not a substitute for a browser or stack journey. Known gap: no test covers the Settings UI switching the backend end to end.

## Known limits

- The interpreter implements a subset by design. A new Cypher construct in `persistence` / `query` fails loudly with a `CypherError` on the local backend until the interpreter learns it; the `local`-mode suite run above is what catches that.
- The local store is single-writer (one sidecar) and held in memory, which suits single-user graphs of a few thousand nodes.

Opening a crystallographic CIF (for example `cif/NaCl_Fm-3m.cif` produced by an analysis session) in the Mol* viewer showed an empty scene and `Error: No models found.` in the log panel. Once it loads, a crystal is only readable as its unit cell, so the cell is now shown too.

## Cause

`MolstarWindow` mapped every `.cif` to Mol*'s `mmcif` parser. A crystallographic (CIF core) file describes atoms with fractional coordinates (`_atom_site_fract_x`, `_cell_length_*`) and has no Cartesian `_atom_site.Cartn_x` column, so the mmCIF parser returns zero models. Mol* does distinguish the two, but only when it auto-detects the format; passing `mmcif` explicitly bypasses that.

## Fix

`cifTrajectoryFormat()` in `molecular.ts` returns `cifCore` when a file has fractional coordinates and no Cartesian ones, and `mmcif` otherwise (including files that carry both). `MolstarWindow` uses it for `.cif` structures and keeps the existing mapping for every other format. Format detection itself is unchanged: both flavours are still `cif`.

## Show the unit cell

The default Mol* preset draws only the asymmetric unit and keeps the cell box hidden, so rock salt loaded as two atoms with no cell. For CIF core files the window now applies Mol*'s `unitcell` preset, which expands the symmetry into the fully populated cell and draws the cell box; if Mol* declines the preset it falls back to the default preset with the cell shown. mmCIF and the other formats keep the default preset. Mol*'s typings only expose the two-argument `applyPreset`, so the call goes through a minimal structural type.

## Validation

- Reproduced with Mol*'s own parsers (bundled headless) on the real `NaCl_Fm-3m.cif` from the affected session: `mmcif` returns **0 models**, `cifCore` returns **1 model**. The new detector picks `cifCore` for that file.
- Headless Mol* plugin on the same file: the `default` preset yields **2 atoms** (asymmetric unit only), the `unitcell` preset yields **384 atoms in 192 units** with the cell box node created. The count is 192 operators × 2 sites: the file lists the full Fm-3m operator set, so special positions are generated many times over and coincide exactly (8 distinct positions), which draws identically but inflates atom counts and selections. That is how Mol*'s preset treats a full operator list, not something this change adds.
- `molecular.test.ts`: 4 passed, including a core CIF, a mmCIF, a file carrying both, an upper-case tag and empty input.
- web `tsx --test tests/*.test.tsx`: 790 passed, 0 failed. `tsc --noEmit` clean.

Not run: `pnpm ci:ut`, `ci:st` and `ci:e2e`. This host is macOS without `bwrap`, which `ci:ut` and `ci:e2e` need, so please read the CodeArts result on this merge request.

## E2E user journeys

**BLOCKED.** I did not open the Mol* window in a browser against a running stack, so the rendered structure is unverified; what is verified, headless, is that Mol*'s CIF-core parser turns the file into a model, that its `unitcell` preset expands it to the full cell with the cell node, and that the window now selects that parser and preset. Whether the cell box and atoms look right on screen is unchecked. Coverage gap: no browser journey opens a CIF in the Mol* window.

Pressing stop on an Evolve run left it on "stopping…" for minutes, with the search still burning CPU.

## Cause

The API only asks the sidecar to set a stop flag. The engine already abandoned in-flight model calls, but every scoring process was launched with `subprocess.run`, which nothing could interrupt. One evaluation may take up to `timeout + 30` seconds, and the workers kept starting new ones after the flag was set.

Observed on a live run (`00b41d50`, custom_script, 16 expansions): stop requested at 10:40:25; at 10:42:20 the run was still `running`, and the sidecar had a `bwrap … python` evaluator child at 1m47 of CPU time that had started at 10:40:33, eight seconds *after* the stop request.

## Fix

All in `services/evolve`:

- `sandbox_run.run_killable` replaces the three `subprocess.run` launch points (`custom_script`, `test_gate`, `dataset_metric`). It polls the stop predicate every 0.25s, kills the whole process group when it turns true, and refuses to start a process once the search is stopped. Timeouts behave as before and also kill the group.
- The stop predicate is passed to `script_domain`, `test_gate_domain` and `scorecard_domain` from both engines. A stopped evaluation returns an invalid result (`the search was stopped`) instead of raising, so it is not reported as a broken evaluator and the run does not fail.
- A completion made after the stop is returned empty without sending the request. Every expansion still queued used to fire a real, paid model call and abandon it half a second later.

## Validation

- New tests with real processes: a stop ends a `sleep 60` within 3s; a grandchild the process spawned is killed too; a stopped search launches nothing (checked by a marker file); the timeout still applies and still kills; without a predicate it behaves like `subprocess.run`; `run_candidate` reports a stop as a stopped candidate rather than a crash. At domain level, a stop ends a 60s evaluator in flight (under 6s) and reports `valid=False`, score `-inf`, error `the search was stopped`; a stopped domain starts no evaluation. And a stopped run sends no further model requests.
- `services/evolve` `pytest tests`: 326 passed (was 316), including the live sandbox tests on this host.
- The branch merges cleanly with the open evolve branches (#157, #159).

Not run: `pnpm ci:ut`, `ci:st` and `ci:e2e`. This host is macOS without `bwrap`, so the Linux `bwrap` path is covered only by the process-group kill tests here; please read the CodeArts result on this merge request.

## E2E user journeys

**BLOCKED.** I did not press stop on a running search in a browser against a stack with this change, so how long a real run takes to wind down after stop is unmeasured. What is verified is that each launch point ends its process quickly and starts none after the stop. Coverage gap: no journey starts a slow search and stops it.

Paired: [GitHub #83](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/83) ↔ [GitCode !157](https://gitcode.com/openJiuwen/sciencediscovery/merge_requests/157)

Two changes to the Evolve (program evolution) surface: the run title no longer prints the user's whole brief, and `get_evolve_run` now hands the agent the winning text.

## Run title

A run's goal statement is the user's full brief, kept verbatim because the search reads it, and the panel header printed all of it: audience, hard constraints and a scoring rubric in a 16px heading.

`evolveShortTitle()` keeps the first sentence, drops a leading `任务：` / `Task:` label and cuts at 64 columns (a CJK character counts as two). The panel shows that as the heading with the full task in a "Full task" fold; the run card shows it too, with the whole statement still in its tooltip. The stored statement is unchanged.

## Results the agent can use

`get_evolve_run` returned scores and a one-line `bestChange`. The winning text was already published as an artifact (`evolve/<run>/…`, v1 the starting point, v2 the winner), but nothing told the agent its name, so an agent asked to apply a finished search had nothing to write and set about rebuilding the program from the one-line summary, which yields one that was never scored.

A finished search that beat its starting point now also returns:

- the winner's full text in its own `<best_candidate>` block rather than as escaped JSON, cut at 30,000 characters with the real length and the artifact name when longer;
- `resultArtifact`, the artifact whose version 2 is the winner;
- `bestCodeHash`.

The winner is the node the engine names in `search_finished`, the same one the orchestrator publishes. A search still running, or one where nothing beat the seed (node 0 or `null`), returns none of the three. The tool description tells the agent to write the text to the file it replaces and never to rebuild it from `bestChange`.

## Validation

- Read a real run from the affected server (13 candidates, the huawei_intro task): the engine's winner is node 3 with score 0.09375 (#3 in the candidate list), its `expanded` event carries a `codeHash`, and the candidate file reads back (492 characters). `summariseRun` picks that same node.
- `evolveShortTitle` tests, including the exact task text from the report: 4 passed.
- `packages/evolve`: 9 passed (winner as its own block, cut winner, no winner). `services/api` evolution tests: 153 passed, 1 skipped, including winner selection for a finished, seed-won, `null`-best and still-running search.
- web `pnpm test`: 794 passed, 0 failed. `tsc --noEmit` clean for web, schema, evolve and api.

Not run: `pnpm ci:ut`, `ci:st` and `ci:e2e`. This host is macOS without `bwrap`, which `ci:ut` and `ci:e2e` need, so please read the CodeArts result on this merge request.

## E2E user journeys

**BLOCKED.** I did not open the panel in a browser, so the heading, fold and card are unchecked visually, and I did not have an agent call `get_evolve_run` and write the text back. What is verified is the title function, the summary logic on a real run's events, and the tool's output format. Coverage gap: no browser journey opens an Evolve run, and none drives an agent from a finished search to the file.
